fusions.name: Lime in the Eyes
fusions.desc: Throws a fistful of lime dust around you, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to confuse each one for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pulled Keystone
fusions.desc: Pulls a keystone loose at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 9 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Blunted] for 6 seconds. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Loose Paver
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, lays a loose paving stone at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 18 damage and leaves the enemy [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mischief in the Mix
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
